name: fixed_eval_v1_anymal_c
purpose: Evaluate an Isaac-Velocity-Flat-Anymal-C-v0 run's final checkpoint under the fixed_eval_v1 condition (same grid, horizon, seed, accounting), independent of the run's own training settings. Training randomization events that the Go2 task does not have are disabled in the evaluation environment only.

env_changes.commands: overwritten every step with the grid command assigned to each env

driver: evals/fixed_eval_task.py (frozen evals/fixed_eval.py with the env_events_disabled events set to None after parse_env_cfg)
accounting: each env contributes only its first episode; a fall is base_contact before the time limit
